title: Pilo
description: A quiet desktop workbench for the Pi coding agent. Two themes (Lody Light, Lody Dark = bundled Vesper) register the same role names; exactly one accent hue is permitted, and every text token is calibrated to 4.5:1 against the surface it renders on.

surface.description: Cards, the sidebar panel, code blocks.

foreground-muted.description: Card and sidebar body text, icon glyphs.

muted.description: Disabled fields, tab strips, chip backgrounds.

hover.description: The one hover colour in the app.

border.description: Layout dividers and resting surface edges.

primary.description: Action, selection, running. Scarcity is the design.

primary-foreground.description: Text on any solid accent fill.

ring.description: Visible against the page; never carries text.

secondary.description: Secondary buttons, input border in light.

muted-dark.description: One step off the canvas so hover/selection are visible.

border-dark.description: Doubles as the dark hover fill.

primary-foreground-dark.description: Black. Never white on the amber.

ring-dark.description: Same hue as the dark accent.

typographyMeta.source: Self-hosted via @fontsource (latin-400/500/600/700). No Google Fonts, no CDN.
typographyMeta.scaleNote: Weight carries hierarchy, not size. The whole UI runs at 14px except three roles: 18px sidebar brand, 24px card title, 30px empty-state hero. There is no fourth display size.

shadows.note: Dark needs roughly 4x the alpha of light. Floating surfaces always pair a tight contact shadow with a wide ambient one - two stops, never one, never three.

motion.themeSwitchGuard: .pilo-theme-switch disables every transition for one frame

layout.grid: Tailwind 4px grid; 8px inside a control row, 16px between groups, 24px card padding

radiusMeaning.md: 6px - controls: buttons, inputs, sidebar rows, chips, tabs
radiusMeaning.xl: 12px - floating surfaces: sidebar panel, composer, menu surface
radiusMeaning.full: 999px - circular: icon-only buttons, composer send key, confirm chip

namedRules.name: The Scarce Accent Rule
namedRules.rule: primary is permitted on exactly four things: the primary action, the focus ring, the active selection, and a running state. Nothing else.

namedRules.name: The Calibrated Text Rule
namedRules.rule: Every text token must clear 4.5:1 against the surface it actually renders on, 12px monospace included. src/index.css records the ratio in a comment beside the value.

namedRules.name: The Whole-Pixel Hit Area Rule
namedRules.rule: Visual size may go below 24px; the hit area may not. Dense row actions are drawn at 20x20 and extended with after:absolute after:-inset-0.5.

namedRules.name: The Two-Step Destructive Rule
namedRules.rule: Destructive list actions never fire on the first click and never open a modal. The control swaps to a rounded-full confirm chip; blur, pointer-leave, or Esc cancels.

namedRules.name: The No-Transition-On-Theme-Switch Rule
namedRules.rule: Theme changes apply transition: none !important to everything for one frame via .pilo-theme-switch, so a re-light is instant and does not smear.

themes.note: Both themes register the same role names. Components carry no dark: colour overrides.

components.name: button-secondary

components.name: text-field
components.description: Editable control: outline from border-strong, fill from field, no glow on focus.

components.name: chat-composer
components.description: The signature surface. A rounded-xl box whose border is the only thing that changes on focus.

components.name: sidebar-row
components.description: 28px dense row. Actions are invisible until the row is hovered and extend their hit area with a pseudo-element.

components.name: status-chip
components.description: 20px chip. Status variants are the only tints in the system, so status never looks like a button.
